title: Influencing the Influencers: Evaluating Person-to-Person Influence on Social Networks Using Granger Causality *
reasoning: The paper focuses on analyzing person-to-person influence on social media using a computational method (Granger Causality). It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. The subject matter is political communication and misinformation, but it is approached from a social network analysis perspective, not an ethical or moral one.
